Quang Trung
A historical figure in Vietnamese history, known by his regnal name Quang Trung, who was a prominent politician and military leader. He was the second emperor of the Tây Sơn dynasty.

Hồ Thơm
A former name of Quang Trung, used before he changed his name to Nguyễn Huệ.

Nguyễn Huệ
The regnal name of Quang Trung, which he adopted later in his life. He was a key figure in Vietnamese history and the second emperor of the Tây Sơn dynasty.

Nguyễn Nhạc
One of the brothers of Nguyễn Huệ, known as one of the Tây Sơn tam kiệt. He was a leader of the Tây Sơn uprising.

Nguyễn Lữ
Another brother of Nguyễn Huệ, known as one of the Tây Sơn tam kiệt. He was a leader of the Tây Sơn uprising.

Tây Sơn tam kiệt
A term referring to the three brothers-Nguyễn Nhạc, Nguyễn Huệ, and Nguyễn Lữ-who were leaders of the Tây Sơn uprising and played a significant role in unifying Vietnam.

Tây Sơn
A revolutionary movement and subsequent dynasty in Vietnamese history, led by the Tây Sơn tam kiệt. It aimed to overthrow the existing ruling powers and unify the country.

Đàng Trong
A historical region in Vietnam, specifically referring to the southern part of the country, which was ruled by the Nguyễn lords before being overthrown by the Tây Sơn rebels.

Đàng Ngoài
A historical region in Vietnam, specifically referring to the northern part of the country, which was ruled by the Trịnh lords and the Later Lê dynasty before being overthrown by the Tây Sơn rebels.

Cuộc khởi nghĩa Tây Sơn
The uprising led by the Tây Sơn tam kiệt, which aimed to overthrow the Nguyễn lords in Đàng Trong, the Trịnh lords, and the Later Lê dynasty in Đàng Ngoài, ultimately leading to the unification of Vietnam.

Quân Xiêm La
The military force of Siam (modern-day Thailand) that invaded Vietnam during the late 18th century.

Quân Mãn Thanh
The military force of the Qing dynasty (China) that invaded Vietnam during the late 18th century.

Trận Ngọc Hồi - Đống Đa
A significant battle in 1789 where Quang Trung defeated both the Siamese and Qing armies, marking a major victory in the Tây Sơn dynasty's military campaigns.
